description:
The sBTC peg as an agent-readable feed — the one dataset only Stacks state can answer. Live sBTC supply (and share of the peg cap), peg-in and peg-out flows for 24h and 7d (sats, counts, unique recipients, net), in-flight bridge requests (pending and accepted deposits with the oldest pending age, pending withdrawals, 24h failures), the last peg events with Bitcoin txids, the signer set and signature threshold, and the rolling withdrawal cap with its current headroom. Read from the sBTC token and registry contracts and the bridge API (Emily); a source that fails degrades to null plus a note. Signer liveness is not public and is reported as null — the pending ages and withdrawal headroom are the proxies.

Use when: An agent wants the state of the sBTC peg before moving BTC onto or off Stacks, sizing against the withdrawal cap, or reading Bitcoin-capital flow into Stacks as a signal.
Not for: you need the sBTC price or market data — token_price / token_market_data are free; you need a swap quote — pre_trade_check prices Bitflow. This call settles $0.01 on-chain.
